input.quote: If M&I and Customer are unable to agree upon the terms for renewal of this Agreement at least six (6) months prior to the expiration of the Term, then Customer may, at its option, renew this Agreement for one (1) twelve month period at the then-current terms and conditions of this Agreement. Customer shall exercise its option, if at all, by delivering written notice to M&I at least five (5) months prior to expiration of the Term.
input.rationale: There is no automatic renewal anywhere in the Agreement (a document-wide search for "renew"/"automatically renew" returns only § 2.2). Renewal occurs only by mutual written agreement following M&I's renewal proposal, which matches the playbook's preferred position. Customer bears no non-renewal notice obligation and no exit window — the Agreement simply expires if the parties do not agree. The only unilateral right is Customer's own option to extend for a single twelve (12) month period at then-current terms and conditions: a customer-favourable right, limited to 12 months (not multi-year), with no price uplift, so no CPI/3% cap is needed. M&I's 18-month proposal deadline and the 6-month response / 5-month exercise mechanics are scheduling steps for a negotiated renewal, not a notice window Customer must hit to escape an auto-renewal, so the walk-away test on notice windows is not engaged. Compliant at the preferred position; no redline.
